rejected_videos.reason: Video only demonstrates GROUP BY with aggregate functions (MIN). Searched the full transcript for 'join' and 'where' usage: JOIN is only mentioned once as a forward reference to a future video ('we'll look at that in our joins'), never demonstrated, and no WHERE clause filtering appears anywhere. The concept's required facts are specifically about combining FROM/WHERE/GROUP BY and including a JOIN in that combination, neither of which this video shows.

Video teaches the formula for calculating a required sample size from a target confidence level and margin of error (a reverse-engineering calculation exercise, two worked formula problems). It never explains or demonstrates why a larger sample size produces a more precise/trustworthy point estimate -- the concept's actual required facts (f1, f2) and learning objective (comparing two same-estimate results with different sample sizes) are not addressed; this is a different skill that happens to share vocabulary (sample size, margin of error, confidence level).

The line-chart portion (453-513s) only shows switching an already-built chart to the line type via the Change Chart Type dialog and picking which data series to display -- it never explains what makes a line chart suited to time-series/trend data (required fact f1), and doesn't demonstrate creating a line chart from scratch via Insert (f2's creation flow), only a type-switch on an existing chart. Too thin to support even a single covered fact honestly.

Pie charts get one passing mention while the presenter is browsing the Change Chart Type gallery ('there are a ton of different options like a pie chart um like this it's it's you know you can try to figure this out') -- no explanation of what a pie chart shows, when it's appropriate, or how to build one. Not enough to support any required fact.
